input.objective: The Hooks Store, job 7: launch safety. The owner's first real launches showed that a request the swarm cannot finish still spends the fee, so this job makes a post-payment question almost impossible and carries every open finding. (1) Fee wording: in src/blocks/catalog.json every fee sentence (Swap fee, Different buy and sell fees, Whale fee, Volatility fee, Buyback jar, Prize pot, Fee that fades, and any block that says the ETH side or settled in ETH) names the pair currency for both the fee side and the settlement: IMD for a type A launch paired with IMD, ETH otherwise; an IMD-paired request adds the sentence 'do not convert the fee to ETH and do not use any other pool'; 'my wallet' is written as the paying wallet's address; the treasury choice reads IMD's treasury and writes 0x3f252e859a277a86A3967c11D4E054B2f07a1F22 (SPEC 5.1, decisions 17 and 18); update the fixtures and add composer tests for every block under every type and pairing. (2) A consistency check runs on every composed request before the free check and before Launch, and locks Launch with a red notice naming the sentence when a fee side or settlement does not match the pair currency, a recipient is not an address, a block depends on a pool, token or service with no address on the deploy chain, or two rules contradict each other; unit-test it on the composed output of every block under every type and pairing. (3) Fixed facts: when the free check's response carries a fixed fact that conflicts with the request (such as the IMD-side fee being sold for ETH while the request keeps the fee in IMD), the What the swarm understood panel shows the conflict and Launch stays locked until the request opts out explicitly; the composer adds the opt-out for IMD pairs by itself. (4) Hook page: a job IMD reports as blocked shows the builder's question as IMD reports it under Needs attention, read through the relay from GET /jobs/:id (blockedReason and the failed node's failureReason), with a button Fix in Builder that reopens the draft that produced the request with the question beside it; the launch's request is kept so the relaunch is a corrected request. (5) Known questions: src/blocks/known-questions.json lists past builder questions as rules the check applies; the first entry is launch 2's question, which asked for an IMD/ETH conversion pool because the fee sentence said ETH while the pool was paired with IMD. (6) Copy: the fee table and the Launch page say that a request the swarm has to stop on still spends the fee and that these checks exist to make that rare (SPEC 6.3 and 6.7). Carry-overs from jobs 5 and 6: remove the hat drawn over Pepe's head in src/scene/pond.ts (drawHat) and keep the far boat and the birds (SPEC 9, decision 16); a confirmed cancelled or replaced launch transaction in web/src/LaunchReview.tsx fails with a working retry instead of staying pending with the flow locked; when a reorg removes a request, the pond ticker in web/src/Landing.tsx drops its announcement and stops showing its age; reproductions are in https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/evidence/job-6-reviews.md. Refresh SPEC.md from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/SPEC.md (now 1.25). Everything else from job 6 stays as delivered. Deliver source, dist/ and test results under tests/results/job7: unit, relay, Playwright at 320, 390 and 1440 for every route, and the live-RPC settle test.
